text: Which. im confused. How is there any divergence between one or t he other if its the same thing just now loaded into a react component ?
resolution: Closed the divergence by removing the generic Scene3D substitution seam: /compiled is now a native WorldLoader node painted by the engine directly through world_loader.zig. Remaining camera divergence was identified as event-loop ownership and fixed by forwarding editor mouse input into the loader runtime.
